stories.title: Menai Suspension Bridge repairs delayed until autumn 2027 after water found in steelwork
stories.summary: The Welsh Government deputy transport minister has expressed his “extreme disappointment and frustration” after further delays to historic bridge works were announced. stories.title: Teenager charged with 20 offences after thefts from cars across Flintshire and Wrexham
stories.summary: A 16-year-old has been charged with 20 offences, including thefts from cars, reported across Flintshire and Wrexham. North Wales Police said the offences were reported between August and September. The charges include nine counts of theft from a motor vehicle and four counts of vehicle interference. stories.title: Airbus launches video series to draw young people into aerospace engineering
stories.summary: Airbus has launched a video series following apprentices and young engineers at its UK sites, as it tries to draw more young people into aerospace jobs. stories.title: Three indoor padel courts are on the way to Deeside Leisure Centre
stories.summary: Three indoor padel courts are to be built at Deeside Leisure Centre, with the courts expected to open in spring 2027. Gwella, the company that runs Flintshire’s leisure centres and libraries, said the courts are being paid for with support from Sport Wales. stories.summary: Mold High Street is closed on Tuesday and Aston Road in Queensferry is shut until next Monday, among road closures and temporary traffic lights planned across Flintshire this week.
